item.title: Aquis weekly movers: Gledhow Investments new focus
item.summary: Gledhow Investments (LON: GDH) has received commitments for a £400,000 subscription at 1p/share, which was more than double the market price at the time. It is also acquiring Penina Resources in return for 21.9 million shares, and this bring £219,000 in cash.
